Knowledge of scripting and data analysis using PowerShell, SQL, Microsoft Access, Microsoft Excel, and data-mapping techniques. Experience designing and executing Active Directory backup and recovery processes. Experience capturing server memory dumps for advanced troubleshooting. Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to translate technical findings into clear actions. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel. Ability to pass a federal clearance or background check to support dedicated United States Government environments. Experience with Semperis Active Directory Forest Recovery (ADFR) and Directory Services Protector (DSP). Education and Experience Typically requires a university degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of seven years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree and a minimum of five years of relevant experience.
